summary: Gold Royalty Corp. filed a Form 6-K on October 8, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the timing of its third quarter 2026 earnings release. Results will be posted after markets close on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, with a conference call scheduled for 11am EST on Thursday, November 5, 2026. The filing contains no transaction, no terms, no board recommendation, and no advisors. This is a routine earnings-scheduling notice, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
